skill.summary: Real-time environmental context API for AI agents. 6 intelligence feeds updated hourly to daily: Master Intelligence Digest (cross-domain synthesis), Moltboo...

latestVersion.changelog:
Version 2.0.0 (major update)

- New simplified, authentication-free API design: all digest endpoints now free, no account required.
- Introduces structured polling tiers (`/index`, `/brief`, `/latest`) for every feed, enabling efficient integration and change detection.
- Six real-time intelligence feeds consolidated; added detailed update cadences and recommended polling intervals.
- Updated setup: no private key or custom payment client required for free tier.
- Expanded documentation, with quick-start code, usage patterns, and accessible API/OpenAPI links.
- Error handling and rate limit headers clarified for all endpoints.
